Dear Hiring Team,

I'm applying for the Sales & Account Manager (Digital Services) role. With a background in digital marketing and hands-on experience managing client websites, I understand what it takes to sell and support digital services that deliver real results.

In my current roles, I work directly with clients on SEO, content, and web projects—coordinating timelines, communicating needs to the internal team, and ensuring deliverables match expectations. I've built and optimized sites for consultancies, e-commerce stores, and associations, which gives me the technical insight to explain value and handle objections confidently. I'm comfortable with cold outreach, CRM tracking, and using tools like Google Analytics and Semrush to report on performance.

I'm fluent in English and eager to bring my relationship-building skills to a dynamic team. I'd welcome the chance to discuss how I can contribute to your sales and account management efforts.

Best regards,

cover_letter:
Dear Hiring Team,

I'm writing to apply for the Sales & Account Manager (Digital Services) position. While my CV may not show a traditional sales title, my experience as a digital marketer has been deeply client-facing—managing relationships, coordinating projects, and ensuring that the digital services I help deliver actually meet client needs. That's the core of this role, and I'm confident I can do it well.

In my current freelance and junior digital marketing roles, I work directly with clients on SEO, content, and web projects. I act as the main point of contact, translating their requirements into clear tasks for the internal team, setting timelines, and following up to ensure satisfaction. For example, I built and optimized mirook.com for a youth chess champion, handling everything from technical SEO to content—and I regularly communicate progress and results to clients. This has taught me how to maintain trust, prevent churn, and spot opportunities to upsell or extend services.

I also have experience with cold outreach and lead generation. I've used email and LinkedIn to connect with potential clients, and I'm comfortable using CRM tools to track pipeline and follow-ups. My technical background in web development and SEO means I can explain digital services in a way that resonates with clients and handle objections with substance. I'm fluent in English and used to working remotely with international teams.

What draws me to this role is the mix of sales strategy and relationship management. I enjoy the challenge of closing deals and the ongoing work of keeping clients happy. I'm eager to learn your specific processes and contribute to your outbound efforts. I'm confident that my blend of digital marketing knowledge and client-facing skills makes me a strong fit.

Thank you for considering my application. I look forward to discussing how I can help your team grow.

Sincerely,
Baver Ok
cv_highlights:
• Client-facing digital marketing experience: managing SEO, content, and web projects for consultancies, e-commerce stores, and associations, acting as the main point of contact.
• Proven ability to coordinate timelines, communicate client needs to internal teams, and ensure deliverables align with expectations.
• Hands-on lead generation and outreach: using email and LinkedIn for cold outreach, tracking progress in CRM tools, and supporting outbound campaigns.
• Technical background in web development and SEO (WordPress, HTML/CSS/JS, Google Analytics, Semrush) enables clear communication of digital service value and objection handling.
• Fluent English and experience working remotely with international teams; eager to contribute to sales strategy and client retention.
